capabilities: Display all images from the current note in a gallery view
Open images in a lightbox with zoom and keyboard navigation
Filter images by local or remote and sort by size or note order
Cache remote images on disk with configurable size and expiration
Copy or download images from a context menu
extras: The README lists privacy disclosures: no account, telemetry, or ads; network requests only occur when the note contains remote image URLs and the gallery is opened. Also available in Simplified Chinese, and marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Inspired by various image gallery plugins in the community
problem: Obsidian shows images inline as they appear in the note, with no way to browse, filter, or zoom all images in a note from one view.
summary: Image gallery plugin that displays all images from the current note in a waterfall layout with a lightbox viewer, filtering, sorting, and remote-image caching.
